The room is yours.

One private space in Jabalpur, booked by the session. Nobody walks in, nobody rushes you out, and the setup changes to match whatever you're celebrating.

Ask us anything We'll call you back, and send a confirmation by email.

SpecWhat's in it

Built for one group
at a time.

Privacy
The whole room reserved for your group, start to finish. No shared seating, no second booking running alongside yours.
Screen & sound
Big-screen projection with a dedicated sound system.
Seating
Lounge seating arranged around your group.
Capacity
Up to 7 guests. Sessions start at ₹1,500; the tickets page has the price for each setup.
Session
90 minutes, start to finish. Karaoke is 30.

Decoration, cake, flowers and a photoshoot available with Date Night.

House rulesSo everyone gets the same room

A short list, and we mean all of it.

Yes, please

  • Your own playlist or filmWelcome
  • Your own cakeTell us first
  • Decorating something yourselfTell us first
  • Photos and video of your own groupWelcome
  • Running over by a few minutesIf the next slot is free

Please don't

  • Smoking inside the roomNot allowed
  • Moving the screen or speakersAsk us
  • Open flames you brought yourselfAsk us
  • More guests than you booked forTell us first

If something here would spoil your plan, ask — most of it is a conversation, not a rule.
